title: MPC-based federated learning model training and prediction method, system, device and medium

pse.problem: Existing federated learning models cannot ensure full-process security protection due to data exchange of intermediate calculation results.
pse.solution_function: The invention implements MPC-based federated learning for N nodes to cooperate in training a model, preprocessing local data sets, augmenting feature data sets, sharing and receiving data set fragments, generating training sample set fragments, and training the federal learning model parameters using a multi-party safety computation protocol.
pse.solution_structure: Key components include N nodes (each with local data sets), MPC protocol for secure communication and computation, and federal learning model.
pse.solution_implementation: Local data preprocessing follows predefined rules (missing value processing, outlier processing, feature transformation, normalization). Augmented local feature data set is fragmented and shared with other nodes using MPC. Training sample set fragments are generated by splicing and aggregating local and received data set fragments. Model parameters are trained using the training sample set fragments and a multi-party safety computation protocol.
pse.effect: Improved full-process security protection in federated learning, addressing data islanding problem and ensuring user privacy.
